versions.content: The DL field states the amount of the actual data bytes, according to ISO 15765-2 the values 0x1 – 0x7 (0x6 in FRARTP_ISO6 mode) are valid, so in an ISO 15765-2 compliant connection the size of the associated N-PDU has to be, depending on the addressing mode, 10 (9) or 12 (11) Bytes long, since the SF has this length.
